title: Hydration Mismatch & Full Subtree Bailout
description: Step through how streaming SSR, non-deterministic client state, and hydration bailout wipe active form inputs.

steps.label: 1. Streaming SSR Flush
steps.description: Server flushes HTML chunks immediately with UTC locale formatting and default query state. User sees the search input and starts typing.

steps.label: 2. Full-Tree Hydration Boot
steps.description: JS bundle finishes downloading. Framework must walk and re-execute the component tree to bind event listeners.

steps.label: 3. Mismatch & Subtree Bailout
steps.description: Client evaluates new Date().toLocaleTimeString() or window.location.search. Text node differs from SSR HTML; framework bails out of hydration.
steps.codeHighlight: // Error #418: SSR '14:02 UTC' !== Client '6:02 AM PST'

steps.label: 4. URL State Divergence
steps.description: Uncontrolled client URL parsing (hash or default params) diverges from server-rendered route props, widening the bailout to the layout shell.

steps.label: 5. Router Re-Mount & Input Wipe
steps.description: Client router mounts fresh DOM nodes for the bailed-out subtree. Focus drops and the user's typed text in the search input is wiped.
